stories.title: A cathartic win 293 days in the making: Hanging in The Grove for Lane Kiffin's return
stories.summary: After unmatched hype and buildup -- and an epic scene at The Grove -- Ole Miss got the best of Lane Kiffin and LSU.

stories.title: After loss, LSU's Kiffin shows 'gratefulness' for Ole Miss tenure
stories.summary: After his LSU Tigers fell to the Ole Miss Rebels 32-24 on Saturday night, coach Lane Kiffin spoke of the "emotions of gratefulness" he has for Oxford, Mississippi, and the six years he and his family spent there, a tenure that "went well beyond football."

stories.title: Ole Miss coach Golding: Beating LSU 'sweet' but not 'our Super Bowl'
stories.summary: While Ole Miss is basking in its victory over former coach Lane Kiffin and his LSU Tigers, Pete Golding cautioned that his team is aiming for higher goals this season.

stories.title: Federal prosecutors identify 18 alleged rigged pitches for Clase trial
stories.summary: Prosecutors identified 18 pitches, including one from a 2024 playoff game, that will be the focus of their case against Guardians closer Emmanuel Clase that is set for trial in November, according to court documents.

stories.title: NFL changes rules governing videoboards after ex-coach's viral post
stories.summary: The NFL has modified what can be shown on videoboards during field goal and extra point attempts, an alteration coming in the wake of a viral social media post from a former analytics coach.
